mapper.sql: SELECT scheme_id, scheme_name, period_type, scheme_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_hr_kpi_scheme
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_kpi_scheme (scheme_name, period_type, scheme_status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{schemeName}, #{periodType}, '0', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_hr_kpi_scheme scheme_name = #{schemeName}, period_type = #{periodType}, scheme_status = #{schemeStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE scheme_id = #{schemeId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_kpi_scheme SET del_flag = '2' WHERE scheme_id IN #{schemeId}
mapper.select: SELECT item_id, scheme_id, indicator_name, weight, target_value, score_rule FROM biz_hr_kpi_item WHERE scheme_id = #{schemeId} ORDER BY item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_kpi_item (scheme_id, indicator_name, weight, target_value, score_rule) VALUES (#{schemeId}, #{indicatorName}, #{weight}, #{targetValue}, #{scoreRule})
mapper.sql: SELECT r.record_id, r.scheme_id, s.scheme_name, r.period, r.employee_id, r.employee_name, r.self_score, r.self_comment, r.superior_score, r.superior_comment, r.final_score, r.kpi_status, r.appeal_reason, r.appeal_result, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.remark FROM biz_hr_kpi_record r LEFT JOIN biz_hr_kpi_scheme s ON r.scheme_id = s.scheme_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.period = #{period} AND r.kpi_status IN ('3','5') AND r.final_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.final_score DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_kpi_record (scheme_id, period, employee_id, employee_name, self_score, self_comment, superior_score, superior_comment, final_score, kpi_status, appeal_reason, appeal_result, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{schemeId}, #{period}, #{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{selfScore}, #{selfComment}, #{superiorScore}, #{superiorComment}, #{finalScore}, #{kpiStatus}, #{appealReason}, #{appealResult}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE biz_hr_kpi_record self_score = #{selfScore}, self_comment = #{selfComment}, superior_score = #{superiorScore}, superior_comment = #{superiorComment}, final_score = #{finalScore}, kpi_status = #{kpiStatus}, appeal_reason = #{appealReason}, appeal_result = #{appealResult}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
